description: Unity Foods Limited describes its purpose as providing food for life, transforming crops into products for the food sector. Its portfolio spans premium edible oils, fortified staples (flour, rice, kitchen essentials, lentils and pulses, and salt), frozen foods, confectionery and bakery products, specialised fats, and animal feed ingredients for poultry and livestock. It is a public listed company with Wilmar Pakistan Holdings as an associated concern holding more than 20% of its shares.
headOffice: Unity Tower, 8-C, P.E.C.H.S. Block-6, Jamshed Town, Karachi East, Sindh, Pakistan
